intent: Name the current page as the last, non-navigable crumb of a breadcrumb trail.
typical_uses: The final level of the trail, the page the user is on

dont_use_when.situation: An ancestor level the user can navigate back to

invariants.text: BreadcrumbPage renders a `span` with `role="link"`, `aria-disabled="true"` and `aria-current="page"`: assistive tech hears a disabled link marked as the current page, and it has no href and no tab stop. The three attributes are set ahead of the consumer's props, so a consumer value for any of them replaces the kit's.

a11y.by: breadcrumb.test.tsx asserts role="link", aria-disabled="true" and aria-current="page" on the current crumb

bad.title: The current page given an href through a link
bad.why: The current page is not a destination; a link to it offers a click that goes nowhere new. BreadcrumbPage carries the current-page semantics and is not activatable.
